option_relations.rationale: Lobular capillary hemangioma (pyogenic granuloma) does not match the provided histopathological and genetic findings.
The presence of a somatic KDR mutation and the histopathological features are consistent with tufted angioma with somatic KDR mutation.
Acquired tufted angioma may be related to tufted angioma with somatic KDR mutation, but the genetic findings are more specific to the latter.
Microvenular hemangioma does not match the provided histopathological and genetic findings.
